v1.00.28 W9 — bake, verdict records, and release gates (test workload reduction) (#9638)

* checkpoint: fix red-on-green — boundary accumulator used hasheq with string keys (eq?-nondeterministic); now equal-based hash. raco-fmt canonicalized 4 files. 3x raco + direct runs green

* checkpoint: census guard test cases in metadata-discovery suite + metrics sync (1471 test files)

* checkpoint: fix round-1 empty-records crash in census-collect; add regression test

* recovery(W0): census progress heartbeat — coordinator fix after 2026-09-08 crash

The 2026-09-08 q crash during W0 execution started with a silent census
log: the canonical serial run (1177 files x 3 samples, jobs=1 by design)
prints one header line and then nothing for hours, so the executor
misread it as a zombie and entered a kill/restart spiral that ended with
'for p in $(pgrep -x racket); do kill $p; done' — killing q itself
(BUG-0066).

This adds one flushed progress line per attempt (counter, round, file,
status, duration, elapsed) so a long run is always distinguishable from
a hang. No manifest-schema or pass/fail semantics change; --check
contract untouched (tests/test-runtime-census.rkt green).

Coordinator recovery commit on the W0 branch; see
.planning/bugs/BUG-0066-bash-guard-self-matching-process-kill/.

* W9 gate fix: derive 36 test-side version literals from q-version (BUG-0009 lint green)

check-version-expectations.rkt runs in CI (ci.yml lint job). The W9
version bump turned 36 hard-coded '1.00.28' literals across 21 test
files into CI-red violations; the previous repair deferred them as
out-of-scope, which would have blocked the Delivery-Contract PR.

Conversion follows the repo convention (tests/fixtures/ci-cohort/*):
 - behavioral strings (wait-audit path + wave label, lint-release-notes
   fixture artifact links, redundancy package labels) now derive via
   (format "v~a…" q-version) — byte-identical today, auto-tracking on
   future bumps;
 - comment/doc-string references reworded to wave-only citations
   (comments cannot interpolate; main carries zero version literals in
   tests for this exact reason).

check-version-expectations: PASSED (0 literals / 1475 files).
Behavioral test files re-verified green from a cold compiled/ purge
(deterministic-clock, redundancy-candidates, lint-release-notes,
pristine-git-fixture, ci-cohort-report). Full fast suite re-run in
progress on this exact tree; committed with the pre-commit hook active
(no --no-verify).

* W9: resync README test-lines metric after BUG-0009 literal conversions

* W9: pin @timeout 300 on delivery-verifier suite (git-fixture-heavy, ~123s > 120s default cap)

The suite needs ~2m03s standalone; the runner's default 120s per-file
cap turned it into a deterministic local timeout and a coin-flip in CI
under parallel load. Uses the existing @timeout metadata override
(same remedy as tests/test-audit-script.rkt). README metrics resynced.
